Admin routes of the attributes module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/attributes

List product attributes

Parameters:

- `page` in query (string, required).
- `pageSize` in query (string, required).
- `productTypeId` in query (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Attributes retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## POST /v1/admin/attributes

Create new attribute

Request body: [CreateAttributeAdminDto](#createattributeadmindto).

Responses:

- `201`: Attribute created.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## DELETE /v1/admin/attributes/{id}

Delete attribute

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `204`: Attribute deleted.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Attribute not found.
- `409`: Attribute in use.

## PATCH /v1/admin/attributes/{id}

Update attribute

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdateAttributeAdminDto](#updateattributeadmindto).

Responses:

- `200`: Attribute updated.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Attribute not found.
